about: Craft checklist, department screenwriting (P3b, docs/CRAFT_CURRICULUM.md). Same shape as training/video_criteria.json, plus artefact (the field the check reads), source (docs/research/CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10.md section and verdict, the repository rule, or 'Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified)') and enforced_by (an existing path, a planned validator with its phase in planned, or manual). check = code (a validator measures it), critic (the script-critic or editorial review ticks it), eye (the creator's or Claude's look at the frames), manual (a person does it). Every number is a BP id in sourced_rules.json; nothing here is binding: no row has two verified source types yet. Skill: .claude/skills/narration-script/SKILL.md.

criteria.name: no AI-register word over the density limit (delve, tapestry, testament to, ...)
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §1 (PARTIAL): arXiv 2404.01268 and 2406.07016, LLM style-word drift; the word list itself is NOT FOUND

criteria.name: no structural AI tells: stacked triplets, sentence-initial 'Imagine', a rhetorical-question opener in every segment, em-dash chains, 'not just X but Y'
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): the structures were seen only in unopened blog snippets (CRAFT_SOURCES §1)

criteria.name: the twist sentence lands inside its estimated spoken length
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): twist <= 4.5 s, 0.39 s a word (CRAFT_SOURCES §13)

criteria.name: causal chain: THEREFORE / BUT joins, no AND-THEN chain
show, don't tell and full immersion (no trait statements, no meta disclaimers)
no double exposition: the narration never describes what the picture already shows
criteria.artefact: narration line vs its shot card

criteria.name: sentences for the ear and spoken register
